question: Can an offline preflight detect substitution or mutation of original logger bytes, converted CSV, instrument manifest, or frozen run plan relative to a declared capture manifest?
baseline: Existing dry_run_integrity.py hashes the parsed measurement CSV, not the original logger and run-plan bundle
results: 22/22 fictional-only regression tests passed in each of two separate clean CPython 3.13.5/Linux directories; normalized test-name/status outputs identical; elapsed times differed

ci.scope: 14 origin + 26 dry-run + 22 capture-chain fictional-only tests; no physical instruments
ci.verified_from: GitHub Actions completed jobs and inspected raw job logs

negative_controls: unsafe path traversal, aliases and symlinks
duplicate JSON fields and nonfinite constants
claim_boundary: Byte consistency of a declared bundle only; no proof of real instrument source, CSV conversion semantics, thermal comfort, energy savings or efficiency
decision: Preserve prototype/documented R&D stage; require physical dry run and controlled comparison per issue #15
